main_text.l: מִקְטָר m. מִקְטֶרֶת f. Suffimentum, Thymiate-rium, Thuribulum.
קְטַר Chal. Ligare, Colligare, ortum ex Hebraeo קָשַׁר, Literis ש & ט permutatis.
קִיס m. Chal. Aeftas, Dan. 2.35, ex Hebraeo קִיץ, Literis ץ & ט promore permutatis.
קִיר m. Paries, Murus: plur. קִירוֹת.
קָל m. Chal. Vox, Sonus: ex Heb. קוֹל.
קָלָה Affare, Torrefacere. Niphal נִקְלָה Vilescere, Vilipendi, Vilem haberi. Hiphil הִקְלָה Vilipendere.
קָלִי m. Toftum: & cum Aleph קָלִיא.
קָלוֹן m. Vilitas, Levitas, Ignominia. קִיקָלוֹן. Vide supra in קוּא.
קָלוּט קָלַט m. Contractus, Curtus membro uno.

page.notes: The Hebrew headwords and cross-references are copied from a small scan and several vowel points and letters are uncertain; the Latin glosses are reliable. The stray Hebrew in the entry for קִיקָלוֹן and the cross-reference "קוּא" may be misplaced or misread. The word "promore" and the form "Arathuraria" are doubtful. The catchword is the Hebrew at the lower right.
